title: Golden dataset capture, version 0
description: How the legacy path is replayed for one custodian and what is captured from it per business day: where the historical files are, how Splitter/Loader is run on them in non-production, and the queries that read the outputs and rejections back. Secrets are named by environment variable, never written here.

sources.description: Source config ids the datasets are the oracle for.

business_days.description: Days a delivery is expected; the capture walks these between --from and --to.

location.description: Where the historical files are: a directory, or s3://bucket/prefix.

pattern.description: Glob of a business day's files with date tokens {yyyymmdd}, {yyyy}, {mm}, {dd}; for example GCUS_{yyyymmdd}_*.dat.

replay.description: Command that replays a business day's files through Splitter/Loader in non-production. Placeholders: {files} (paths, space separated), {file_list} (a file listing the paths, one per line), {business_date}, {yyyymmdd}, {work_dir}.

connection_env.description: Environment variable holding the non-production Loader database connection string.

additionalProperties.description: SQL that reads one output back for the business day. Placeholders: {business_date}, {yyyymmdd}, {file_names} (quoted, comma separated). Must ORDER BY so the capture is reproducible.

outputs.description: The outputs captured per business day, by name: loaded tables and the rejections.

rejections.description: Which output holds the Loader rejections.
